Prove your worth once and for all by single-handedly defeating the mighty [[Glacial Griffon|Glacial Griffon]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak to Sif when you are ready to face the Glacial Griffon.
* Destroy the Glacial Griffon and prove your valor to Sif. Earn your song!
* See Sif Shadowhunter for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Norn reputation point]]s
* {{skill icon|"I Am Unstoppable!"}}
* [[Perfect Salvage Kit]]
** Uses Remaining: 5

== Walkthrough ==
After talking to Sif, you will be taken to an empty Sifhalla, where after a short period of time, the [[Glacial Griffon]] will spawn. Defeat it and you will be returned to town to turn in the quest.

===Skill recommendations===
{{see|Cold as Ice/Guide}} ''for a detailed walkthrough''
* Display the Norn title for the additional maximum health from [[Heart of the Norn]].
* [[Interrupt]]ion.
* [[corpse|Exploit corpse]]s in the area. 
* [[Self heal]]ing skills.
* Many [[PvE skills]] apply a number of damaging conditions or provide an extra ally, including [[Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support]], [[Summon Ruby Djinn]], [[Mental Block]].
*Counters to Griffon:
** Bring [[anti-summon skill]]s to counter the spirits.
** Bring your own spirits: the standard [[spirit spammer|spirit lord]] works well.
** Bring [[health degeneration]]: take advantage of its lack of healing by countering its natural health regeneration 
** Bring [[Energy denial]]: prevents it from creating the spirits.

== Notes ==
* During the quest, there are six exploitable [[White Wolf]] corpses.
* You get credit for completing this quest if you kill the Griffon, even if you die.
